title: Club Membership: senior discount and referral credit by tier
content:
## Scope
This document states, for every Club Membership tier, the additional senior discount percentage and the one-time referral credit basis for referring a new member.

## Senior discount
An additional discount is applied for members who are at or above the age threshold of the club's senior discount campaign. Off-Peak Metro Access is the only tier carrying a nonzero senior discount, at 10 percent; every other tier's senior discount is 0 percent.

## Referral credit
| Tier | One-time bill credit per successful referral | Cap on referral credits in a rolling 12-month window |
|---|---|---|
| Base Club Access | $20.00 | 4 |
| Student Metro Access | $15.00 | 4 |
| Off-Peak Metro Access | $20.00 | 4 |
| Metro Multi-Club Access | $25.00 | 6 |
| Premier All-Access | $30.00 | 6 |
| Black Card All-Access | $40.00 | 8 |
| Founding Legacy Access | $20.00 | 4 |

## Reading the table
The referral credit cap counts every referral credit granted to the referring member's own account within the trailing 12 months; once a tier's own cap is reached in that rolling window, a further referral in the same window earns no further bill credit under this basis.
